summary: plan.md fixes the form of all five plots at the brief's exact coordinates: the tower has pale blue-grey laced legs that step in at y46, stacked X-bracing, an arched crown girder and ball finials to y71; the deck is a Warren truss with roads at y29 and subway tracks at y23. Cable heights come from the given formulas; the anchorage is rusticated granite with a round-arch vault (crown y19) over a cobbled plaza. Brief conflicts I settled: the deck runs through the legs as through a portal, the x6 leg columns sit on girders at y20..21 and y32..33, cables end in a slab (no full top to spawn on), and the stacked Xs make the brief's three panels. Block ids are checked for 1.21.1; nothing has been built or rendered yet.
